title: Task Specification
description: Canonical machine-readable representation of an engineering task.

schema.description: Identifies the schema and version this document conforms to.

task_id.description: Unique identifier for the task (e.g. TASK-101, imp-51, bug-12).

repository.description: Repository or project name / relative path.

objective.description: Natural language summary of the task objective.

acceptance_criteria.description: Concrete, verifiable criteria required for task completion.

constraints.description: Hard operational, architectural, or security constraints.

risk_level.description: Assessed operational and security risk level.

required_skills.description: List of skill names required to execute this task.

preferred_agent.description: Optional user or policy override specifying the preferred agent ID.

recommended_agent.description: Agent type recommended by deterministic router.

actual_agent.description: Agent type that actually executed implementation.

is_override.description: Whether an operator override altered the routed agent.

override_reason.description: Explicit rationale for human operator routing override.

allowed_tools.description: Whitelist of tools or capabilities allowed for this task.

prohibited_actions.description: Actions strictly forbidden during task execution.

verification_requirements.description: Required verification checks (e.g. unit tests, lint, build).

reviewer_requirements.description: List of specialized reviewer roles required before completion.

human_approval_requirements.description: Actions or boundary conditions that require human sign-off.

current_state.description: Current lifecycle state of the task.

task_journal_path.description: Relative or absolute path to the active task journal.
